laws.rule: In the Bouches de Bonifacio nature reserve (Lavezzi islands and the southern Corsica coast), the founding decree prohibits landing and moving about inside the protected perimeters, except on the beaches and marked trails at Lavezzi and a few other named places; driving and parking on land; and camping or bivouacking. Using fire in a way that harms the environment is prohibited. This is the decree as first published in the Journal Officiel in 1999; later amendments and a maritime prefecture order on boat access may add to it.
laws.heading: Décret de 1999 créant la réserve naturelle des Bouches de Bonifacio, arts 11, 25, 26, 28

laws.rule: In the same reserve, dogs and other domestic animals are prohibited in the protected perimeters (working dogs excepted); spearfishing is prohibited; collecting giant pen shells, giant limpets and date mussels is prohibited; sea urchin fishing is closed from 1 April to 30 November; and damaging or taking uncultivated plants, minerals or fossils, or disturbing animals, is prohibited without scientific authorisation. Organised sports and tourist events on land are prohibited.
laws.heading: Décret de 1999, arts 8, 9, 14, 18, 20, 22, 27

laws.rule: Flights below 150 metres over the Bouches de Bonifacio reserve need a prefectoral exemption (state, police, rescue and reserve aircraft, and traffic to Figari airport, are excepted). A drone is an aircraft, so this limit is the one that applies to it.
laws.heading: Décret de 1999, art 29

sources.title: Décret portant création de la réserve naturelle des Bouches de Bonifacio (1999)
